name: @kandown/desktop
description: Tauri 2.x desktop wrapper for kandown. Spawns the system `kandown` CLI and opens a native window pointed at its daemon.

scripts.dev: tsc --outDir src --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --strict --skipLibCheck src/main.ts && tauri dev
scripts.build: tsc --outDir src --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --strict --skipLibCheck src/main.ts && tauri build
